description: This file serves as an entrypoint script for running a FastAPI application with Uvicorn. It ensures the project root is added to sys.path to handle module imports properly, and then starts the server with configurable environment variables for host, port, reload, workers, and log level.

methods.name: None _ensure_project_root_on_path()
methods.description: Ensures that the project's root directory is on sys.path so that 'src' modules can be imported regardless of current working directory.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Launches the Uvicorn server with the application module 'src.api.main:app' and configurable options via environment variables.
